    Bug 1909675 - Ignore sha1 warnings in RNP code. r=dandarnell,kaie
    
    This is third party crypto code, better to ignore these than try fixing.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D217756

diff --git a/third_party/rnp/moz.build b/third_party/rnp/moz.build
index 136c07bc9ad..2e2a1d6e462 100644
--- a/third_party/rnp/moz.build
+++ b/third_party/rnp/moz.build
@@ -193,6 +193,9 @@ SOURCES += [
     "src/libsexpp/src/sexp-simple-string.cpp",
 ]
 
+SOURCES["src/lib/crypto/sha1cd/sha1.c"].flags += ["-Wno-unsafe-buffer-usage", "-Wno-extra-semi-stmt"]
+SOURCES["src/lib/crypto/sha1cd/ubc_check.c"].flags += ["-Wno-unsafe-buffer-usage"]
+
 if CONFIG["MZLA_LIBRNP_BACKEND"] == "botan":
     SOURCES += [
         "src/lib/crypto/bn.cpp",
